units: <cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 12:2">Ḥull. XII, 2</cite> <he>ק׳ זכר</he> a male partridge (which is believed to join the female in brooding).
<cite ref="Chullin 140b:12">Ib. 140ᵇ</cite> <he>ק׳ נקבה</he> a female partridge. Tanḥ. Ki Thetsé 2 <he>הק׳ הזה מביא וכ׳</he> the partridge brings eggs of other birds and hatches them; a. e.
